title: Erlebnis-Sennhütte Alpine Hut St. Anton am Arlberg
name: Erlebnis-Sennhütte Alpine Hut St. Anton am Arlberg
kurzbeschreibung: Erlebnis-Sennhütte in St. Anton am Arlberg at 1,500 m: world's largest edelweiss with over 100,000 blossoms, the WunderWanderWeg trail, and authentic alpine charm.
beschreibung:
Overview

The multi-award-winning Erlebnis-Sennhütte sits on a sunny high plateau above the world-renowned alpine resort of St. Anton am Arlberg (Bezirk Landeck) at an elevation of around 1,500 metres. Cradled by the dramatic mountain panorama of the Lechtaler Alpen and the Verwallgruppe, this traditional alpine lodge run by the Senn family has evolved from a classic mountain tavern into an acclaimed sensory and nature haven. With exceptional attractions centring on alpine herbs, beekeeping, and mountain botany, the destination attracts delighted visitors of all generations every summer.

World Record Edelweiss & WunderWanderWeg

The Sennhütte gained global renown for its official Guinness World Record Edelweiss: on a meadow measuring over 1,000 square metres, more than 100,000 authentic alpine edelweiss plants have been planted in the shape of a colossal edelweiss blossom, blooming in luminous white during the summer months. A raised wooden viewing walkway leads directly through this sea of flowers. Encircling the hut is the diverse WunderWanderWeg: at interactive sensory stations, visitors encounter more than 1,000 distinct alpine and medicinal herbs, walk barefoot along tactile paths, and revitalise their senses in Kneipp hydrotherapy stations. In the display apiary, glass observation hives provide an intriguing look into the life of a bee colony. Children enjoy an extensive adventure playground featuring a rustic wooden skittle alley and a petting zoo.

Visit & Getting There

Erlebnis-Sennhütte and the WunderWanderWeg are open during the summer season from mid-June to late September, daily from 10:00 to 18:00. Access to the outdoor grounds, the herb nature trail, and the World Record Edelweiss is completely free! Getting there: from St. Anton am Arlberg, a scenic and family-friendly hiking trail (via the Maiensee trail or forestry track) leads up to the hut in a leisurely 40-minute walk. Alternatively, the hut can be easily reached by e-bike or taxi service. Rail travellers can reach St. Anton comfortably via international express trains (ÖBB/Railjet).

Tips

The sunny terrace of the Sennhütte serves award-winning regional cuisine and traditional Tyrolean pasture delicacies – highly recommended are the homemade herbal lemonades, fluffy Kaiserschmarrn pancakes, and the Arlberg dumpling trilogy. A splendid family outing that pairs wonderfully with a continuing hike to the picturesque Maiensee lake.
